name: io.github.Servosity/veeam-mcp
title: Veeam VSPC MCP
description: Sync Veeam Service Provider Console tenants to local SQLite; cross-company backup answers offline.

environmentVariables.name: VEEAM_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your VSPC appliance REST API base URL, e.g. https://vspc.example.com:1280/api/v3 (per-instance).

environmentVariables.name: VEEAM_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the VSPC REST API (POST /token with your portal credentials).

environmentVariables.name: VEEAM_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 for a read-only server: the API execute tool, sync, import, export and the learning-store writers are hidden, so only reads reach Veeam. Leave blank for the full tool set.

environmentVariables.name: VEEAM_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of Veeam data: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, nothing new is written to the local store, and sync is refused.

environmentVariables.name: VEEAM_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token that veeam-mcp --transport http requires from every HTTP client (Authorization: Bearer, 32 characters or more). Leave blank for the default stdio transport, which Claude Desktop uses and which never reads it.

environmentVariables.name: VEEAM_MCP_UPLOAD_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Leave blank: a file sent through an MCP upload must then be base64 file content. Set it to a folder only to let MCP uploads name files inside that folder; no path outside it can be read.

environmentVariables.name: VEEAM_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Veeam requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
